original_source.paper: Siniscalchi, Ackerfield & Folk (2023), International Journal of Plant Sciences

fixed_preplanned_test.source: EAzami East Asia earlier hypothesis; preselected before NA outcomes
fixed_preplanned_test.discrete_model: symmetric ER Mk CTMC with equal root-state prior; exact edge endpoint posteriors
fixed_preplanned_test.continuous_model: Brownian reconstruction of published contemporary taxon climate centroids
fixed_preplanned_test.tree_length_units: published dated nuclear chronogram (Ma), not a single dated transition
fixed_preplanned_test.null: 999 fixed-D-count randomly reassigned tip states within North America; one-sided; not a fully phylogenetic or geographic null

botanical_mixed_head_exclusion_sensitivi.cause: Flora of North America states erect or nodding; original authors assigned fixed U; sensitivity removes both

ecological_interpretation.supported: A positive prespecified combined BIO15/BIO1 directional statistic in an independent North American nuclear and botanical source panel; insensitive to removing two externally ambiguous head states.
ecological_interpretation.axis_caveat: The reconstructed signed BIO15 component is strongly positive, but the signed BIO1 component is weakly positive rather than the predeclared negative sign. The signal is therefore carried primarily by precipitation seasonality; the temperature-axis direction is not reproduced in branchwise reconstruction.
excluded_claims: historical paleoclimate measured on a true U→D transition event
posterior on number or calendar date of actual state changes
causation, pollinator mechanism, selection or adaptation
full phylogenetic and spatial null calibration
unique white flower loss/re-emergence, since colour class 2 pools white/pink/purple
